name: Apache APISIX
description: Shows the routes an Apache APISIX gateway publishes: host names, the upstream (also through a shared upstream or a service), redirects, whether a route is switched off, and the TLS certificates with their expiry date. Read-only: it only sends GET requests, with the key of the built-in viewer role.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
